name: Verge Sport
verdict: Verge Sport is the custom cycle clothing company founded by Mike Magur in 1996, with its own production facility. Nothing found.
note: US-founded custom cycle apparel maker (base in New York, head office in Poland, own production facility); the team's kit maker and an upper-chest sponsor from 2026.
